about: Sitting 6b (the classroom's and the infirmary's evening and night) written early by hand on 11 Oct 2026, straight after the owner chose 6a ('Lets go with your picks, they all look good!'), from the two chosen day pictures (the classroom's version B, the infirmary's version A), which are NOT installed: each fitted to 1920x1080 and laid into a scratch root with a scratch manifest; the prompts are the tool's own relight prompt with the hour sentences below.

The classroom's night follows O38 to O40 (lights off, moonlight), offered as the default. The infirmary's night is painted two ways: with its lights on low, because the two memories that show it ('Two in the Morning', 'Four in the Morning', sb_memories.rpy) are time with Shoko while she works there; and with every light off. Both night sentences say that what stands outside the windows stays (the lesson of 4b).

Judge without installing: tools/py_art.sh tools/install_redo.py --relight <place> <evening|night> <a> <b> --dry --against <the chosen day render>, then by eye against the day picture for anything added.

sentences.evening: Change the time of day to early evening: low warm orange sunlight slants in through the windows, long soft shadows cross the floor, and the sky outside is orange and pink.
sentences.night_off: Change the time of day to night, with every light in the room switched off: the ceiling lights and every lamp are dark. Outside the windows it is night, under a deep blue sky with stars, and everything that stands outside the windows is still there, as dark shapes against the sky. The room is lit only by cool blue moonlight coming in through the windows, which lies in pale patches on the floor and the furniture. The room is dim, but everything in it can still be seen clearly.
sentences.infirmary_night_late: Change the time of day to the middle of the night: outside the windows it is dark, under a deep blue sky with stars, and everything that stands outside the windows is still there, as dark shapes against the sky. The room's own ceiling lights are switched on and turned low, and fill it with a soft warm light and soft shadows; the monitor on the desk glows. Add no new lamp.

renders_kept_in: ~/Desktop/JJK Game images/ui2/early/renders/ (the ten files as ComfyUI saved them on 11 Oct 2026)

read_11_oct.install_redo_dry: Classroom: all four PASS on the points (the room has no keep list, so nothing else is checked). Infirmary: both evenings PASS; the working-late night A PASS, B LOOK (the top-left of the picture drawn differently: two ceiling lights that are not in the day picture); the lights-off night A PASS, B REFUSED for a floor row under a grid of moonlight, the false alarm already on the installer's list.

by_eye.classroom_evening: both faithful, nothing added, the roof and the cedars still outside. B is the lighter and easier to read (mean 110 against 103); A is a heavier orange and its right-hand side goes brown.
by_eye.classroom_night: A is faithful: every light off, moonlight across the desks, the roof and the cedars as dark shapes outside. B ADDS a tall bookshelf left of the blackboard and a low shelf with a globe on the right.
by_eye.infirmary_evening: B keeps the cedars outside the window, lit orange, and throws one beam across the wall and the bed. A REPLACES the trees outside with open sunset sky.
by_eye.infirmary_night_working_late: A: the monitor glows, one ceiling tube that the day picture already has is on low, the trees are still outside; it reads as someone at work there in the small hours. B ADDS two round ceiling lights and changes what is outside the window.
by_eye.infirmary_night_lights_off: both faithful: monitor dark, moonlight on the floor, the trees outside. A is the plainer to read.

read_11_oct.my_picks: Classroom: evening B, night A. Infirmary: evening B; night 'working late' A, because the two memories that show this picture are time with Shoko while she works there (the lights-off A is the faithful alternative if the owner wants the room dark like the others). Put to the owner; nothing was chosen when this was written.
read_11_oct.lessons: Saying that what stands outside the windows stays kept the trees in all six nights. The evening sentence does not say it, and one evening of four lost them: say it in every hour sentence. Bookshelves appeared in the classroom again, in a relight this time: the room wants a keep list with its bare front wall named.
